meta.source: IRS Uniform Lifetime Table + Single Life Expectancy Table (Treas. Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-9, effective 2022; IRS Pub 590-B Appendix B Tables I & III); SECURE 2.0 start age
meta.notes: Anyone born 1960 or later -> RMDs begin at age 75 (a 1975 birth reaches that in 2050). RMD = prior Dec 31 pre-tax balance / divisor at attained age. singleLifeTable: IRS Single Life Expectancy Table (Pub 590-B Table I, post-2022 values), ages 50-70, used for SEPP 72(t) fixed-amortization payments; values cross-checked 2026-08-12 against two independent published copies of the 2022 table (see VERIFICATIONS.md RMD section).
